history.recommendation_text: The Board also recommended that the Administration rely on the promotion of innovation, capacity-building and improvement of data and metadata exchange to facilitate the achievement of the targets of the Sustainable Development Goals that have matured through the acceleration of data collection for indicators.
history.administration_response: Several facets of data innovation, capacity-building and improvement of data and metadata exchange to facilitate the achievement of the targets are carried out by the Department of Economic and Social Affairs annually and reported to the Statistical Commission for review by countries. In particular, new initiatives on innovative data solutions for the Sustainable Development Goals, guidance on use of citizen-generated data and new tools and guidance for innovation in household surveys are in progress and were well received by the Statistical Commission at its session in March 2022. Please see reports provided – the report of the Secretary-General on the work of the Department of Economic and Social Affairs for the review of the progress towards the Sustainable Development Goals (E/CN.3/2022/3) and the report of the fifty-third session of the Statistical Commission (E/2022/24). The Administration considers this recommendation implemented and requests its closure.
history.board_assessment: Given that the new initiatives on innovative data solutions for the Sustainable Development Goals, guidance on the use of citizen-generated data and new tools and guidance for innovation in household surveys were well received by the Statistical Commission in March 2022, and that some progress has been made, such as on the Global Sustainable Development Goal Indicators Data Platform, which was launched in September 2021, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
